episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A McCoy is murdered by a Hatfield and a forbidden love affair begins at the start of the legendary Hatfield-McCoy family feud.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The Hatfield's seek revenge after one of their own is murdered by a McCoy. Friends and neighbors join the fighting causing the feud to escalate.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The Hatfields are forced deeper into the mountains to avoid the bounty hunters hired by the McCoys and their lawyer; Johnse Hatfield eyes another McCoy woman and the fighting between the two clans escalates to the point of almost being another civil war.
